extended_thesis.bull_deep_dive: Reliance's diversified business model provides multiple growth levers. extended_thesis.bear_deep_dive: The bear case is more nuanced and carries higher conviction. Promoter's history of aggressive capex (₹3.5 lakh crore over 5 years) without commensurate FCF generation raises questions about capital allocation discipline. If crude spikes above $90/bbl due to geopolitical tensions, the stock could de-rate to 20x PE, implying a 30% downside.
